review:
A Mexican fiesta on 5x3 built around money respins. Money symbols carry 1x to 100x or a Mini or Major jackpot, and six or more trigger three respins.

During respins only sticky money symbols land, each resetting the count. When they run out, everything pays, and filling the whole grid wins the Grande jackpot worth 1,000x. Three scatters give eight premium-only free spins that retrigger endlessly. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
